keyConvention.pattern: FACTION_<GROUP>_<VARIANT> — SCREAMING_SNAKE: FACTION_ + group (GREET|TIER_LABEL|TIER_UP|TIER_DOWN|REP_BAR) + tier enum or role.

pluralGenderPolicy.engine: Unreal StringTable + FText::Format (ICU MessageFormat); arms authored in source, carried to every PO. Only {toNext} is a count (TIER_UP_TOAST) — arms proven inline: de(2), ar(=0+5), ja(1: 点), pl/ru(4, one/few/many/other). {playerGender, select} participles inline for fr/ru/pl on GREET_HONORED (default 'other'); {playerName} may be empty — FRIENDLY select-guard drops the comma.

bestContent.lengthPolicy: Fixed-width (hard budget): tier labels ≤22 (EXALTED = DNT title, 24) + assembled REP_BAR ≤56 — both proven (worstRender). Toasts ≤90 (3.0s window). Greetings are subtitle/VO, NOT fixed-width: charLimit is a soft VO budget (±15% of source duration or re-time flag); de 1.35× wraps to a 2nd line, never truncates.

consistency.tierLabelDecoupling: Labels map 1:1 to the enum — enum = math, label = voice.
consistency.vaelLineEchoes: Greetings/labels echo Vael's lines (NPC Members): 'ash on your brow'/'the wall holds'/'recognizes' — one faction voice.
consistency.crossStepGuards: TIER_LABEL_EXALTED == Tier Rewards Exalted title (DNT, byte-identical); REP_BAR_LABEL == Standing UI displayFormat — drift caught by shared-string diff. Vendor discount line lives in the vendors table.

qa.pseudoloc: qps-ploc (+40% + accents + brackets) before target handoff — catches RepBar truncation + toast overflow.
validation: Every {token} declared + present in every declared-locale PO (missing = build fail); all CLDR plural arms present per locale (pl/ru 4, ja 1).
doNotTranslate terms verbatim; cross-step guards (REP_BAR_LABEL, EXALTED title) hold; no gender inflection asserted without all gendered arms; no manual RTL reordering (bidi isolates only).

promptTechnique: Treat a loc step as a SOURCE-of-truth asset, not a key list. The produce prompt must (1) dump every sibling step first and mine them for the real strings the keys resolve to (tier ladder, per-tier NPC lines, HUD displayFormat, reward titles), then author each key with: source-locale text + explicit interpolation tokens + a per-key translator context note + a hard/soft char budget tied to the actual widget. (2) Decouple mechanical identity from display: keep the internal enum that drives math, but give each label a world-flavored DISPLAY string so voice cannot contradict the numbers. (3) Prove the hard i18n cases INLINE rather than asserting them — author real ICU plural arm sets per CLDR category (ar =0+one/two/few/many/other, pl/ru one/few/many/other, ja 1-arm), gendered {playerGender,select} participles for gendered locales, an empty-{name} select-guard, RTL via FSI/PDI bidi isolates (never manual token swaps), and a COMPUTED worstRender (longest factionName+label+grouped numbers with a byte count) against the widget budget. (4) Bind to siblings with byte-identical cross-step guards (label == reward title, rep-bar == HUD displayFormat). (5) Give source strings a faction-specific voice pass (concrete world imagery + reused faction idioms) so tier escalation reads as one voice, not a reputation template. Depth of authored, verifiable proof — not length — is the entire lever; text has no model wall.
